# Standard: https://llmstxt.org

## Site Name
Chalu Ghadamodi (चालू घडामोडी)

## URL
https://chalughadamodi.in

## Description
Chalu Ghadamodi is a free Marathi-language current affairs platform dedicated to students
preparing for Maharashtra government competitive examinations. It provides daily current
affairs in Marathi, free monthly PDF magazines, practice tests, and static general studies
content. All content is 100% in Marathi (Devanagari script) and free of charge.

## Supported Examinations
- MPSC (Maharashtra Public Service Commission) — Rajyaseva, PSI, STI, ASO
- Talathi Bharti (तलाठी भरती)
- Maharashtra Police Bharti (महाराष्ट्र पोलीस भरती)
- Railway RRB Group D, NTPC
- SSC GD (Staff Selection Commission General Duty)
- Vanrakshak Bharti (वनरक्षक भरती)
- Saralseva Bharti (सरळसेवा भरती)

## Content Types
- Daily Marathi current affairs (रोजच्या चालू घडामोडी)
- Monthly current affairs PDF magazines (मासिक PDF — free download)
- Practice tests aligned to MPSC and other exam syllabi
- Static GK / General Studies linked to current events
- Job/recruitment notifications (नोकरी भरती जाहिराती)
- Student testimonials

## Language
- Primary: Marathi (मराठी) written in Devanagari script
- Region: Maharashtra, India
- ISO 639-1: mr
- BCP 47: mr-IN

## Audience
Maharashtra competitive exam aspirants (विद्यार्थी) — primarily ages 18–30 preparing
for state and central government jobs.

## Mission
To provide every Marathi-speaking exam aspirant with free, high-quality, exam-relevant
current affairs so that coaching fees are never a barrier to government job success.

## Unique Value
- 100% free — no login, no paywall, no subscription
- Marathi-first — all explanations in native Marathi
- Exam-mapped — content tagged by syllabus topic
- Static GS integration — current events linked to static general knowledge
